speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The second step is mine, Master Heminges. The foot of the stair is yours. You will not trade them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The foot of the stair it is. I have a custard from my wife, in a cloth, and I have a question under it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am come down as far as the cap allows. Ask it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The king is billed for tomorrow. The Inns have written it down. Gaunt has a face like a loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know the face. I cannot play it with this jaw.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You cannot. Pope will do it. He has nothing till the garden in the third act.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He'll die at Ely House and rise a gardener.

speaker: john_heminges
text: He'll get a laugh on this England.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: He had the roll last night, and Mistress Pope says he was near weeping at it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the roll stays with him. I will not send for it. A man near weeping does not want an author added to the room.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Garnish has cut the long cue for him. I have not brought you a length, and I will not make one up on a stair.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not make one up. If it is cut, it is cut. I am not fit to count a length today.

speaker: john_heminges
text: One thing more, and then your landlady may have her way. The Rose has a new play today. Something of a woman and a wonder.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let them. We've a king and a custard.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He is to have the custard and no more talk.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the custard, and I am gone. I will not come above the second step.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tell Pope to play it plain. If he is still weeping at noon, a laugh was not the bargain.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I will tell him plain. I will not tell him how to weep.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The cloth stays on the table. The man does not stay in the house. Mark me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will eat what she brought. I will not go up tomorrow to watch a loaf die. Tomorrow is his.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tomorrow is his. Today you have sugar, and a cap, and a hole where a tyrant was. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. Thank your wife for the cloth. I have not the jaw for a longer grace.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The custard is on my table. The stair above this step is still mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I am fed when I have eaten it, and the question is settled. I do not know the laugh yet, and I will not pretend I do.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I left the roll with Pope. Look for no paper from me today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will look for none. I have the wonder in the one sentence, and I do not need a bill to go with it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You shall not have a bill from me. I do not carry their paper.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. The cap can go back upstairs when the custard is gone. The caller may go with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him go. The king is tomorrow, and tomorrow is not in this cap.
